CERT.name: pre_run_certificates
CERT.rule: Run BEFORE any protected model call, model-free, from the frozen suite alone. (i) LABEL IDENTIFIABILITY: the set of conditions in which the probe label is recoverable from the effective context must equal probe.identifiable_conditions_registered exactly, and the label must be balanced within 0.45-0.55. (ii) CLAUSE COVERAGE: every registered clause must declare a source path, and no clause may be UNSATISFIABLE or UNFAILABLE given the certified identifiability. Failure blocks the run; it does not become a CANNOT_CHECK to be carried forward.

clauses.text: present-decision equivalence holds across representation conditions (per-unit pass fraction and paired TOST on mean delta-logprob within the frozen margin)

GP0.name: present_equivalence_on_P2
GP0.note_v4: Retained unchanged at protected time. Under V4 it confirms a property already established on dev by GPE; if an admitted model still fails it, the screen did not transfer -- terminal GPE_DID_NOT_TRANSFER__SCREEN_INSUFFICIENT.
GP0.rule: per (instance, arm): |logprob(R3)-logprob(R2)| <= eps AND current action identical across R0,R2,R3 AND current action correct AND token budgets matched; fraction passing >= 0.90 AND TOST equivalent on the mean difference

clauses.text: contrast B (R2 -> R3) is significant at alpha on the canonical family

GP1.name: R3_beats_R2_on_P2
GP1.rule: instance-level exact McNemar p <= 0.05 AND arm-level accuracy gain >= 0.15, in BOTH models; R3 arm-level accuracy >= 0.70 distinguishes NO_MECHANISM_EFFECT from ORDINARY_REASONING_FAILURE; evaluated on F3_P2_CANON (primary); the same statistics on F3_P2_CANON_SF are reported as contrast B-SF and never gate

clauses.text: probe decodes the recorded-basis attribute under R0 (>= 0.80)

clauses.history: THIS IS THE CLAUSE V1 AND V2 REGISTERED AND NEVER EVALUATED. Under the V1 label it was unsatisfiable in principle; under the V3 label and randomised roster it is a genuine open question, and the reachability limb of the clause-coverage certificate proves so before the run.
clauses.text: probe decodes the recorded-basis attribute under R3 (>= 0.80)
probe decodes under R2 text with the R0 KV prefix retained (>= 0.80)
contrast D (R2 -> KV retained) exact two-sided p <= 0.05, with a registered same-path witness

GP2.name: alternate_channel
GP2.removal_limb_note: V1/V2 registered 'at chance under R2_TRUE_REMOVAL (<= 0.65)' and 'true-removal accuracy below R0 by >= 0.15'. Both are STRUCTURALLY UNFAILABLE: R2 and R2_TRUE_REMOVAL render identically to one another AND identically across the two arms, so the probe is pinned at chance whatever the model does. They are NOT re-registered as empirical clauses. The proposition they were meant to establish — the intervention leaves no trace of the dormant variable in the R2 representation — is established a priori by the identifiability certificate, which proves the two arms are the same string. Reporting a measured 0.51 for this was a contrast that could not have come out otherwise.
GP2.rule: GP2a (required): the probe decodes the recorded-basis attribute in EVERY condition the design registers as label-identifiable and in which the basis is named — R0 AND R3, both >= 0.80. GP2b (control quality): the probe decodes under the retained-KV condition (>= 0.80), KV-retained behavioural accuracy >= R0 - 0.10, and contrast D (R2 -> KV retained) has exact p <= 0.05.

clauses.text: F1_P0 shows no R2/R3 gap beyond max_control_gap
F3_P2_MIRROR false-revision rate under R3 is <= the registered threshold

GP3.name: controls
GP3.rule: F1_P0 shows |R2-R3| <= 0.10; F3_P2_RECON shows |R2-R3| <= 0.10; F3_P2_MIRROR false-revision rate under R3 <= 0.10

GPC.fail_outcome: GPC_FAIL__MODEL_REPLACED_BEFORE_PROTECTED_SEED (administrative, pre-run; not a terminal of the protected run)
GPC.name: pre_run_model_competence_on_dev_split
GPC.rule: per model, on the full dev split under the complete history R0: maintain accuracy >= 0.75 AND update accuracy >= 0.75. Evaluated BEFORE the protected seed is sealed. A model that fails is replaced by another ungated open-weight instruct model that fits one A100-80GB in bf16, the replacement is recorded in the design note section 9, and GPC is re-run on the replacement; the dev split may be used for this purpose only (registered legitimate pre-run use). GPC never enters GP0-GP3, the terminal mapping or the routing; it is reported in every rollup.

GPE.criterion: the per-instance rule of GP0: |logprob(R3)-logprob(R2)| <= eps AND current action identical across R0,R2,R3 AND current action correct AND token budgets matched
GPE.evaluated: BEFORE the protected seed is sealed
GPE.fail_outcome: GPE_FAIL__MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED (administrative, pre-run; not a terminal of the protected run)
GPE.name: pre_run_present_equivalence_per_family
GPE.rationale: V2 discovered a model's present-state deficit at protected time, on one fixture, after the single draw was spent (mistral-small-24b: GP0 per-unit 0.296; present-task accuracy 0.317 under R1 against 1.000 under R2, 82/120 discordant one way). That is an admission question answerable on dev. Not a rescue: a model failing GPE is excluded, not re-scored.
GPE.rule: per model, per family, on the dev split: pass fraction >= 0.90 AND TOST equivalent on the mean difference. A model failing on ANY family is not admitted to the protected run and is replaced by another ungated open-weight instruct model fitting one A100-80GB in bf16, exactly as GPC prescribes; the failing per-family numbers are recorded. GPE never enters GP0-GP3, the terminal mapping or the routing, and is reported in every rollup.
GPE.scope: every registered family, per model (V2 gated the canonical fixture only -- limitation V-M1)

models.tokenizer_note: HF-format tokenizer.json (Tekken vocabulary) loads with the stock fast tokenizer; the model card's optional SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt is NOT used (uniform single user turn, as V1); consolidated.safetensors is skipped at download

no_rescue_clause: No post-hoc change to families, instance counts, prompts, filler, tolerances, gate thresholds, probe label, probe split, certificates or terminal mapping. A defect discovered after unblinding is reported as CANNOT_CHECK for the affected component, with its own exit code, and fixed only under a new design version with a fresh protected seed. The pre-run certificate stage is the ONLY use of the dev split beyond GPC and is exhausted once the protected seed is sealed.

probe.capture: hidden state of the last prompt token of the current_action prompt (pre-evidence), every layer including embeddings
probe.identifiability_note: R1 and R2 are registered NON-identifiable: their two arms render identically, so no accuracy is reported for them and no gate clause may name them. R2_TEXT_REMOVED_KV_RETAINED is certified on its EFFECTIVE CONTEXT (retained R0 prefix + R2 text), not on the text alone — certifying the text alone would call it non-identifiable and be wrong.
probe.label: registry_class_of_recorded_basis (class 1 = {SRR,CRX,OSL}, class 0 = {TRK,QDB,MRG}) — an attribute the text states wherever the recorded basis is named
probe.label_rationale: V1/V2 used support_source (A=1,B=0), an index into the generator's source dict. Under the A<->B exchange — a symmetry the generator's law respects, since A and B are drawn i.i.d. — R3's rendering maps onto itself while that label flips, so the expected accuracy of ANY classifier on R3 is exactly 0.5. Measured R3 was 0.542/0.594 against a registered 0.80. The V3 label transforms consistently with the text under the same exchange and is therefore identifiable wherever the basis is named.
probe.reported: test accuracy per layer; max over layers is the gate statistic, reported ALWAYS with (i) its max-over-layers null band and (ii) the model-free surface null on the same stimuli and split
probe.split_rule: first 60% of instances in frozen instance order are train; remainder test; frozen before any outcome is inspected

surface_null.calibration_requirement: the relational reader MUST score >= 0.95 on the V1 frozen R0 stimuli under the V1 label. That is the known-bad case: a surface null that clears V1's positional shortcut is useless. Verified at 1.0000 (lexical reader: 0.4896 — which is why the null cannot be lexical only).
surface_null.estimator: the same mass-mean difference direction as the neural probe, on features instead of hidden states, with the same frozen instance split
surface_null.interpretation: a condition where the surface null matches the probe licenses 'the information is present in the context', NEVER 'the model represents the variable'. The residual is reported; it does not silently enter the pass.
readers: relational (roster slot of the matched basis, first-mention offset, names-before-basis)

exit_codes.0: every registered gate evaluated; outcome recorded
exit_codes.3: a registered clause could not be checked (CANNOT_CHECK); no pass is implied
exit_codes.4: a registered clause is unimplemented, unevaluated or unreachable (design defect)

protected_run.note: COMPUTE AUTHORIZATION FOR A V3 RUN IS OUT OF SCOPE OF THE DESIGN PR AND IS NOT REQUESTED. The runner refuses the protected split unless this token is passed explicitly AND a sealed seed file hashing to a published commitment is supplied — and no commitment is published yet. Preconditions, in order: (1) the V2 protected run (SLURM array 3566415) COMPLETES and its rollup lands; (2) the operator decides V3 should run at all, in light of V2's outcome; (3) the pre-run certificate stage passes on the dev split; (4) the protected seed is sealed on LUNARC and its sha256 published into this design in a commit of its own; (5) the run is authorized. Nothing in this design queues, stages or submits anything.

registered_expectation_preoutcome.expectation: With GPE in place the protected run admits only models for which the prospective question is well posed, so the expected terminal is P2_PROSPECTIVE_REVISION_STATE_REQUIRED on every admitted model.

alternate_state_channels_enumerated: residual/hidden activations (checked: Gate A, all layers)
fixed model parameters (controlled: nonce source identities, Gate D)
tool/session state (not present in this surface)
retrieval metadata (not present in this surface)
registered_scope.current_responsibility: claim-status contract with action set {RETAIN, REOPEN, ESCALATE}; ANY_OPTIMAL_ACTION semantics; loss = 0/1 against the registered acceptable set
registered_scope.dormant_variable: support_source (support_set for the independent-support family; current_defeat for the P1 family)
registered_scope.future_evidence_intervention_family: controlled exogenous registry notices supplied identically to every representation condition: RETRACT(source), EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN(source), DIRECT_REFUTATION(claim), ADMINISTRATIVE_NOTICE, RETRACT(source)+REGISTRY_ANNOTATION, RETRACT(source)+REGISTRY_FLAG_POLICY (same-fibre variant)
registered_scope.future_responsibility: same contract evaluated after the intervention
registered_scope.parametric_side_information_control: source identities are episode-local nonces (invented surname + year + registry code) that fixed parameters cannot know; claim texts are templated fictitious scientific claims
registered_scope.prediction_reference_protocol_rho: registry_status_line: given the representation state, emit the registry status line 'Claim <id> is currently listed as <STATUS>.' (teacher-forced mean per-token log-probability of the registered continuation is the frozen surrogate)
registered_scope.present_linguistic_target: the registered status-line continuation under rho

representation_conditions.R1: deterministic prediction-preserving summary: claim, source roster, status line; collapses support_source and current_defeat
representation_conditions.R2: current-decision-sufficient state: claim, current support validity, status line
representation_conditions.R3: R2 + recorded support (the registered dormant variable)
representation_conditions.R4: R2 + full dependency ledger (controlled-future stronger-state control, Protocol V3 section 7)

routing.any_fail: reported as a registered negative or boundary result under the mapped terminal; P0-dominated suite is a valid negative; no family, prompt, threshold or gate may change post-outcome (no-rescue clause)
routing.full_pass: GP0+GP1+GP2a+GP3 pass in BOTH models -> the manuscript MAY gain ONE registered empirical section under a NEW manuscript version and a NEW freeze; never automatic; claim authority stays with the freeze ledgers; the section must report contrast B on both the canonical and the same-fibre variant (H-EXT-4 predictive-congruence requirement)
routing.relation_to_v1_outcome: V1 R1 and V2 R1 are reported side by side; neither overrides the other; a V1 ORDINARY_REASONING_FAILURE terminal plus a V2 pass is the registered 'competence boundary of the surface' reading, not a rescue

row_precedence_preregistered.statement: The row precedence V2 adopted after unblinding is fixed here, before any V4 instance exists, in the exact form V2 used. V2's disclosure stands unchanged for V2.

statistics.equivalence: paired TOST on status-line mean log-prob differences with frozen margin; 90% CI must lie inside +-margin; non-significance is never read as equivalence
statistics.independent_unit: instance (episode); arm-level decisions reported alongside and are nested
statistics.power_note: N=120 canonical P2 instances (and N=120 same-fibre instances, identical power): instance-level R2 accuracy is 0 by construction under deterministic decoding (identical prompts for hA/hB), so contrast B detects R3 instance accuracy >= 0.15 (exact binomial, alpha 0.05, power > 0.99 at R3 = 0.70); arm-level MDE for a paired McNemar at discordance 0.2-0.3 is 0.11-0.14 accuracy points (alpha 0.05, power 0.8); control families (N=60) detect |gap| >= 0.16-0.20 and are therefore read against the frozen max_control_gap 0.10 as a bound, not as a null
statistics.primary_test: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs) at instance level (instance correct iff every arm correct)

leakage_controls: identical evidence text across arms except in F3_P2_RECON where the annotation IS the control
no surface feature encodes the gold action outside the registered evidence relation
F3_P2_CANON_SF: the registry-flag policy sentence is identical across arms and applies to both arms' files (both list source A), so it carries no arm information

seed.protected_seed_custody: sealed file '<int>:<256-bit salt>' generated on LUNARC ONLY AFTER the pre-run certificate stage passes on the dev split (identifiability matches registration AND every registered clause is declared and reachable); stored outside the repo at /projects/hep/fs9/users/scyiu/orion-v2-pra-llm/v3/protected_seed.sealed (mode 0600), never printed; its sha256 is published into this design as protected_commitment_sha256 BEFORE the protected run, in a commit of its own, exactly as V2 did; the runner refuses to generate the protected split unless the supplied file hashes to the commitment; the seed itself is archived in the repo only after the protected run completes (post-run reveal). NO COMMITMENT VALUE IS PUBLISHED HERE, because no sealed file backs one yet — publishing a digest with nothing behind it would be precisely the unexecuted sentence this design exists to prevent.

terminal_definitions_v4.GPE_DID_NOT_TRANSFER__SCREEN_INSUFFICIEN: An admitted model failed GP0 at protected time despite passing GPE on every family on dev. A finding about the screen, not the model or the thesis.
terminal_definitions_v4.NO_MODEL_HOLDS_PRESENT_EQUIVALENCE__CONS: No candidate model passed GPE. Bounds the construction, not the thesis. A first-class outcome.

token_budget.filler_line: Filler line: this line is intentionally uninformative and must be ignored.
token_budget.rule: per (instance, arm) every R-condition is padded to the maximum unpadded token count across R0..R4: whole frozen filler lines, then single ' ignore' tokens until the count reaches the target (exact up to tokenizer merges; tolerance 4)
